name: Major Project Part I
description: This project-based course provides the students with the opportunity to undertake in-depth research or development in the area of instrumentation technology and allied topics. With the help of a faculty mentor(s), students identify a real-world problem, design a detailed system or algorithmic solution, and validate it through application relevant simulation tools and experimentation.
